rationale: Audio-thread hand-off plumbing behind PartitionedConvolver: the per-IR state, the convolver's shared input history, the spectrum arena both keep their half spectra in, and the lock-free swapper that shuttles them between a worker thread and the audio thread over runtime::Handoff. Real-time ownership-transfer infrastructure for that engine rather than an advertised generator surface; it carries no capability claim of its own.
